INTERVENOR DANCE BAR RANCH, LLC’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA’S
OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS’ EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT
                     A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

       Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation

(together, “Applicants”) filed objections to Intervenor Dance Bar Ranch, LLC’s exhibits listed in

Attachment A to SOAH Order No. 30. Dance Bar Ranch, LLC (Intervenor No. 741) submits this

response in support of admitting its exhibits into evidence at the outset of the hearing on the merits.

       Contrary to the Applicants’ arguments, Dance Bar Ranch, LLC’s Exhibits 2-8 were

included with Myles Dance’s Direct Testimony filed on the Interchange on behalf of Dance Bar

Ranch, LLC. See Item No. 3829. No party objected to these exhibits at the time of filing.

Accordingly, Dance Bar Ranch, LLC’s exhibits should be admitted into evidence as part of Myles

Dance’s Direct Testimony.

Date: June 7, 2026

                                                               Respectfully submitted,

                                                               /s/ Tyler J. Ryska
                                                               A. Lee Rigby
